description: This is a Python script for verifying release files by checking SHA512 hashes and GPG signatures, including RSA key and email verification against Apache KEYS.

methods.name: get_sha512_hash
methods.description: Runs the shasum command on a file and returns the SHA512 hash.

methods.name: read_sha512_file
methods.description: Reads the .sha512 file and processes its contents to extract the hash.

methods.name: verify_sha512
methods.description: Verifies if the SHA512 hash of a file matches the hash in its .sha512 file.

methods.name: get_gpg_info
methods.description: Runs GPG verify command to extract RSA/EDDSA key and issuer email.

methods.name: verify_key
methods.description: Fetches the KEYS file and verifies the RSA/EDDSA key and email.

methods.name: verify_sha512_and_rsa
methods.description: Performs combined verification of SHA512 hash and RSA key.
